finiteOperatorModel.displacementConvention: D(x,z)=omega^(2 x.z) X^x Z^z over F_3; on an isotropic plane D(u)D(v)=D(u+v)
finiteOperatorModel.rankOneProjectorFormula: P_(a,b)=1/9 sum_(s,t in F_3) omega^(-as-bt) D(su+tv)

cliffordCompiler.interpretation: Each preparation word sends the computational Z Lagrangian to the target commuting class. Reverse inverse words compile every target basis measurement back to computational readout; outcome relabelling is determined by the transported plane generators.

finiteOperatorModel.interpretation: The 40 Lagrangian planes give all 360 two-qutrit stabilizer states. Each of the 36 elliptic frames selects ten disjoint commuting classes and therefore 90 states in a complete stabilizer MUB.

exceptionalCliqueRecovery.triangleMeaning: the 120 maximal K3s are exactly the symmetric-difference closures of azygetic double-six pairs
exceptionalCliqueRecovery.fiveCliqueMeaning: intersection of the five double-sixes is a unique skew pair of cubic lines; all 216 skew pairs occur once
exceptionalCliqueRecovery.fourCliqueMeaning: the union of the four double-sixes omits one three-line tritangent; each of the 45 tritangents occurs for exactly three K4s

overlapAssociationScheme.interpretation: Every relation-invariant linear operator on the 36 frames is x I + y A4 + z A1 and has only three spectral sectors of dimensions 1, 15 and 20.

heckeCompression.moduleMap: sum or average the twelve incident line flags over each double-six/frame
heckeCompression.interpretation: The 36-frame Bose-Mesner algebra is the fiber-constant Hecke compression of the 432-flag carrier, not an unrelated small matrix algebra.

noiseChannel.stochasticFamily: K = alpha I + beta A4/15 + gamma A1/20, with alpha+beta+gamma=1 and alpha,beta,gamma>=0
noiseChannel.rateInverse: v = r15/12 - r20/18; u = r20/9 - r15/12 for positive decay rates r15=12u+24v and r20=18u+18v
noiseChannel.identifiability: The two nontrivial decay rates recover u and v uniquely; held-out transitions test whether a device respects the association scheme.
noiseChannel.carrierBoundary: This is a Markov channel on frame labels, appropriate to Clifford-valued control noise or a coarse-grained selector variable. A generic quantum CPTP map need not send a complete stabilizer frame to another frame and therefore has an additional leakage sector.
noiseChannel.boundary: A relation-invariant irreducible Markov channel converges to the uniform frame distribution. It cannot select one frame spontaneously as a linear equilibrium process.

selectorDynamics.freeEnergy: F(p)=T sum_i p_i log p_i - 1/2 p^T(j0 I+j4 A4+j1 A1)p - h.p
selectorDynamics.firstInstability: The larger of j0+3j4-4j1 and j0-3j4+2j1 determines whether the first symmetry-breaking mode lies in the 15- or 20-dimensional exceptional sector.

zeroTemperatureRelationOptimization.theorem: By Motzkin-Straus, maximizing p^T A p on the probability simplex gives 1-1/omega(A), attained on uniform distributions over maximum cliques.
zeroTemperatureRelationOptimization.fourBasisAttraction: omega(A4)=4, so pure attractive four-basis coupling has 135 K4-supported optimum clusters, each associated with a tritangent omission.
zeroTemperatureRelationOptimization.oneBasisAttraction: omega(A1)=5, so pure attractive one-basis coupling has 216 K5-supported optimum clusters, each associated with a skew cubic-line pair.
zeroTemperatureRelationOptimization.energies: for F=-j p^T A p/2, the optimum energies are -3j4/8 and -2j1/5 respectively

selectorDynamics.uniqueSelectionBoundary: With h=0 the equations may break symmetry but cannot canonically name one of 36 equivalent frames. A unique frame requires an external field, boundary condition, initial-condition choice, nonlinear history or source-derived asymmetry.

integerControlCostGrid.weightDomain: each of F1,F2,D1,D2,Swap,U independently ranges over integers 1..4
integerControlCostGrid.boundary: This is an exhaustive integer-grid census for weights 1..maxWeight, not a proof that the continuous positive control-cost fan has no additional chambers.

implementationSelector.result: Under the declared logical alphabet and equal gate costs, shortest total preparation length uniquely selects frame 21 with cost 40. When mutual-gate count is minimized first, every frame needs six mutual gates and frames 10, 11 and 21 tie at total length 43.
implementationSelector.boundary: Compiler cost is a real selector only after a hardware alphabet and gate weights are fixed. The control-cost profiles form samples from a selector fan: changes of hardware weights can change the minimizing frame or its degeneracy. This breaks W(E6) symmetry through implementation choices and is not an intrinsic preferred frame of the finite geometry.

liftObstructions.integralCarrier: Reduction Sp(4,Z) -> Sp(4,F_3) supplies the finite carrier and is surjective, so individual finite transformations have integral lifts.
liftObstructions.noEquivariantIntegralSection: A section would embed the order-51840 Sp(4,F_3) into GL(4,Z), but finite subgroups of GL(4,Z) have maximal order 1152. Therefore the full finite action has no faithful four-dimensional integral section.
liftObstructions.realCarrier: The mod-three carrier may be the special fibre of a real/integral symplectic system, but the 36-frame finite symmetry does not lift as the same faithful subgroup of Sp(4,R).
liftObstructions.noFaithfulRealFourCarrier: Every finite subgroup of Sp(4,R) is conjugate into U(2). A faithful PSp(4,3) action there would induce a faithful projective two-dimensional unitary representation, impossible by the classification of finite rotation groups.
liftObstructions.consequence: The integral and real lifts are quotient/transport constructions with congruence-kernel ambiguity, not a canonical embedding of the complete finite configuration.

experimentalBoundary.nearestTest: Prepare and measure the ten stabilizer bases belonging to selected frames on one two-qutrit device; apply calibrated frame-preserving Clifford controls or a coarse-grained selector process; estimate the 36x36 conditional kernel and project it onto span{I,A4,A1}.
experimentalBoundary.leakageTest: First quantify probability mass not describable as any of the 36 frames. Only the conditional frame-preserving component is eligible for the three-parameter association-scheme model.
experimentalBoundary.nullModel: A generic calibrated channel need not be constant on the one-basis and four-basis relation classes.
experimentalBoundary.positiveResult: Small residual outside the three-dimensional Bose-Mesner algebra, plus held-out prediction of both decay sectors, establishes the exceptional incidence as an operational organizing symmetry of that device.
experimentalBoundary.negativeResult: A resolved residual falsifies the relation-invariant dynamics while leaving the exact finite geometry intact.
experimentalBoundary.physicsBoundary: Neither outcome identifies a fundamental interaction, spacetime structure or E8 root carrier.
